This is a purely local client that calls the public interfaces of live platforms directly; the project itself does not store, produce or distribute any audio or video. The developer does not collect, process or keep any personal information: all settings and data stay on your own devices, under your control. Users are responsible for how they use this program.

audience_acfun_detail: Live directory and room details use onlineCount. Likes and followers remain separate; author search has no concurrent count.
audience_bilibili_detail: List online and heartbeat are popularity; WATCHED_CHANGE is cumulative for the session, all kept separate from concurrent viewers
audience_cc_detail: webcc_visitor/hot_score/visitor are aliases for platform heat; only vision_visitor/online_num are current viewers, and both scales remain separate
audience_douyin_detail: Recommendation, search and room payloads prefer top-level or nested user_count as concurrent viewers; display_value/total_user remain cumulative views
audience_douyu_detail: Public ol/hot list fields are treated as popularity
audience_huya_detail: Current list/detail totalCount and userCount plus in-room iAttendeeCount (URI 8006) are all heat in live captures; the public feed does not expose a distinct concurrent count
audience_inke_detail: Public discovery and room details do not expose a verified audience count; missing values stay unknown
audience_kilakila_detail: watchNumber has no verified concurrent-viewer meaning and is not used for real-online ranking
audience_kuaishou_detail: watchingCount is treated as current viewers
audience_looklive_detail: Official recommendations expose onlineNumber as current viewers and keep popularity as a separate platform heat value; missing room-detail counts stay unknown
audience_metric_fallback_desc: Concurrent mode uses only explicit concurrent values. Supported platforms show Pending until data arrives; other platforms retain Heat or Total labels.
audience_metric_settings_desc: Choose platform heat or real concurrent viewers and manage supported platforms separately
audience_metric_support_detail:
Bilibili, Douyu, Huya, and YY: platform heat
Douyin: total views and concurrent viewers
NetEase CC: webcc/hot/visitor heat and vision concurrent viewers
Kuaishou and Twitch: concurrent viewers
SOOP: total concurrent viewers across PC and mobile

Real-online mode uses data only from platforms that explicitly return an online count. Other platforms show their native metric label.
audience_metric_support_summary: See platform support for heat, online counts, and total views
audience_missevan_detail: The public score is platform popularity; no separate concurrent viewer count is exposed
audience_mode_heat_desc: Use each platform list’s heat or cumulative-view field; these values are not concurrent viewers
audience_mode_online_desc: Rank by concurrent viewers only for enabled rooms with an explicit value; other rooms retain their source metric label
audience_niconico_detail: watchCount is cumulative views for the program and remains separate from concurrent viewers
audience_picarto_detail: Directory and room viewers are concurrent viewers; total_views is cumulative and remains separate.
audience_ranking_rule_desc: Ranking order: explicit concurrent counts first, supported rooms awaiting data next, then heat or cumulative metrics. Equal values use stable platform and room IDs to prevent refresh reshuffling.
audience_soop_detail: Recommendation and search prefer total_view_cnt (PC + mobile); categories use view_cnt, explicit platform counts are summed only as a fallback, and missing player-detail counts are not written as zero
audience_source_not_exposed: Source: public platform data has no concurrent count
audience_source_room_realtime: Source: realtime message after entering a room

douyu_cookie_tip:
Step 1 — page cookie: F12 → any Douyu page → copy the whole cookie (with dy_auth, good for about 7 days).
Step 2 — renewal credentials (optional, but this is what makes it renew itself): F12 → Network tab → search https://passport.douyu.com/ → open that request → copy LTP0 and dy_did into the two fields below.
Press "Renew now" to verify them immediately. The cookie is stored on this device only.
douyu_cookie_tip_lifetime: The cookie lasts 7 days; once LTP0 and dy_did are set it is renewed before it expires, so there is nothing to paste again. Press "Renew now" to verify. The cookie is stored on this device only.
douyu_cookie_tip_step1: Step 1 · Page cookie: open any Douyu page, press F12 and copy the whole cookie from any request (it contains dy_auth, good for about 7 days).
douyu_cookie_tip_step2: Step 2 · Renewal credentials: in the Network tab search passport.douyu.com, open that request and copy LTP0 and dy_did from its cookie — pasting it below fills both fields automatically.

webdav_help_intro_body:
Jianguoyun supports WebDAV access for backup and file management. This guide uses a personal Jianguoyun account as an example.
Free plan: 1 GB uploads/month and 3 GB downloads/month. Storage grows with uploaded data. Plans can change; check the official pages before relying on a quota.
webdav_help_issue_browser_a: A WebDAV endpoint is intended for a WebDAV client and may show an authentication prompt or an error in a normal browser. Verify it inside Pure Live.
webdav_help_issue_browser_q: 2. The address looks different in a browser
webdav_help_issue_credentials_a: Check the account email and use the dedicated app password. Regenerate the app password if it was revoked.

webdav_help_issue_revoke_q: 5. Revoke access or reset a password
webdav_help_issue_timeout_a: Recheck the complete HTTPS directory URL and current network or proxy route, then retry from the inline error action.
webdav_help_issue_upload_a: Check the account quota, directory write access, available network connection, and whether the remote file still exists.
webdav_help_limits_body: Jianguoyun's official WebDAV help currently lists a default 500 MB upload limit, up to 600 requests per 30 minutes for free accounts (1,500 for paid accounts), and up to 750 entries per directory response. Provider rules can change; consult the official help page for the latest limits.
